workflow: Multiple threads access a shared mutable counter, with one thread updating it while another reads it to produce a display value.
The update uses synchronized access, but the display path performs an ordinary unsynchronized read of the same state.
The conflicting accesses form a data race, so instrumentation reports failure instead of allowing concurrent operation to complete normally.
summary: Concurrent unsynchronized read of shared mutable counter
decision_reason: The underlying failure is materially the same as workflow-0081: concurrent read/write access to shared mutable storage without matching synchronization. The differing counter semantics and display operation do not change the core race workflow.
